summary: Three clauses are worth reviewing before signing: an open-ended deposit deduction, unequal notice periods, and a 15% automatic yearly rent rise.

flags.quote: any amounts for damages, cleaning, repainting and other charges as the Landlord deems necessary
flags.explanation: The landlord can take money out of your deposit for almost anything, and decides the amount alone. There is no fixed list of deductions and no firm date for getting the rest back.
flags.whyItMatters: Open-ended deductions and a vague refund time make it hard to predict how much of the Rs. 60,000 you will get back. This is worth asking about before signing.
questionsToAsk: Can the allowed deductions be listed specifically, with a cap?
